description: Whether an address was targeted by address poisoning: look-alike addresses that sent it dust, imitating an address it really paid or was paid by, so a careless copy from its history pays the scammer. Each finding names the look-alike, whom it imitates and the real payment.

network.description: Network: BTC, LTC, DOGE, ZEC, BTCTEST, LTCTEST, DOGETEST or ZECTEST.

name: get_address_poisoning
title: Address Poisoning Check
